canonical_definition: Document Understanding is the capability to process and interpret text-rich multimodal documents (e.g., images, charts, tables, layouts) by extracting visual elements, understanding spatial/structural relationships, and integrating this information with linguistic knowledge. It involves tasks like chart interpretation, layout parsing, and positional reasoning, often operationalized as a benchmark for evaluating multimodal systems' ability to handle structured visual-linguistic content. This behavior reflects expertise in combining perception, knowledge, and spatial reasoning to derive structured outputs or explanations from complex document inputs.
